text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Dober-san, about that last race... Um, it 
was so close!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up! It'll definitely be fine this 
time! We're all cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. I'm okay now. I'll do my best 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. Guess I'll... give it my 
best.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine. The coffee didn't spill. 
...I also avoided my 'friend.'"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Doesn't it tire you out? ...Forcing 
yourself to act cheerful, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...When you can't do it, you can't. ...I 
think it's okay to leave it at that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Farewell, clumsy one. ...There are 
times when you just want to be alone, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that's right. Until I finish this 
coffee... just a little longer like 
this..."
